authorization.request: 用户报告 DSH Desktop 商城刷新后不显示插件目录，要求处理当前故障。

objective: 修复 DSH Desktop 商城因 GitHub Raw 目录请求超时或网络失败而无法显示插件列表的问题，并正确显示请求中止错误。

change.rootCause: Desktop Catalog 请求的 AbortError 带有数值 code；原错误处理把该数值当成有效 code 原样抛出，最终显示 DESKTOP_OPERATION_FAILED。Desktop UI 直接请求 GitHub Raw，不复用 Host 侧 Catalog 缓存。
change.catalogDelivery: 继续优先使用 GitHub Raw。仅在网络失败、HTTP 错误或超时时回退到同仓库 GitHub Pages 的 registry/catalog.json。备用响应必须通过相同的精确 URL、4 MiB 大小上限、UTF-8、JSON 和 Catalog 结构校验；界面标示当前使用 Pages。禁止使用比 Raw 落后的 dsh-store.cn Catalog。
change.errorHandling: 识别 AbortError 和中止信号，将其映射到 DESKTOP_CATALOG_TIMEOUT；只把符合安全格式的字符串作为 Desktop 错误码，忽略浏览器数值 code。
change.scopeExclusions: 不写真实 DSH Profile，不安装或重启 DSH，不修改 @deepseek-ai/*、DSH 源码或 Catalog pin；合并源码后如需更新 Catalog，另建绑定完整 Commit 的新鲜计划。

commands.expected: all disposable Desktop compatibility cases pass, including native abort fallback
staged self-pin and version mirrors accept 0.9.43 with Catalog 0.9.42
REGISTRY_OK and full repository suite passes

gates: The plan base Commit remains an ancestor and every scoped precondition hash matches immediately before commit.
Only Raw network/HTTP/timeout failures trigger the pinned Pages fallback; malformed or oversized data fails closed.
Desktop disposable harness proves an AbortError with numeric code falls through to the exact Pages URL, loads the Catalog and shows the mirror notice.
All repository checks, package dry-run, typed-plan verifier and exact-head PR CI pass before merge.
After source merge, Catalog pin advancement uses a separate fresh policy plan; real Profile update and visible Desktop acceptance require a separate confirmed operation.

rollback.source: Revert only this change through a CI-checked PR; current Catalog stays pinned to 0.9.42 until a separate release plan advances it.
rollback.desktopProfile: No real Profile, package or process mutation is included.

healthCheck: Run focused disposable Desktop compatibility tests, npm run check, npm pack dry-run, typed-plan verification and exact-head PR CI. Independently compare Raw and Pages Catalog hashes. Report real Desktop/Profile acceptance separately.

verification.remoteCatalogs: Raw and GitHub Pages returned HTTP 200 and identical SHA-256 e27d2a3e0db1f0dcdee6ffab2690b5ff9807f8ef267a9893956f2f88ba13732f with 883 entries and Store 0.9.42 fixed to 8e51ce905767338a1e7606926ad09b749fc308db; dsh-store.cn is stale at 881 entries and is excluded.
verification.nativeAbortEvidence: AbortError.code is numeric 20; the previous desktopErrorCode selected it before the message and returned DESKTOP_OPERATION_FAILED.
verification.releaseMetadataTests: passed: 68/68 Catalog, package contract, version matrix and embedded deployment bundle cases
verification.realDesktopProfile: unchanged; update and visible UI acceptance require separate confirmation
